<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1295
Claimant:
Dylan Thomas
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
06/28/2023
Claim received by phone from the policyholder reporting a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection. The
claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
07/06/2023
Reviewed the policy declarations and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at
the time of loss.
07/12/2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene and records the same general
sequence of events the claimant described when reporting the loss.
08/13/2023
Collected statements from two independent witnesses, both of whom describe the impact as the claimant has
described it, and both confirm the claimant was seated in the driver's position.
09/11/2023
Received photographs from the scene and from the body shop. The damage to the front end of the claimant's vehicle
lines up with the direction and force of the reported impact.
10/29/2023
Spoke with the other driver, whose account matches the claimant's on the sequence of events and the point of
contact between the two vehicles.
11/04/2023
Ran a prior-damage review on the vehicle using the inspection history and photos on file. No earlier damage to the
affected areas is recorded, and ntohing suggests the damage predates the coverage start date.
11/18/2023
Claimant's counsel submitted a medical summary reporting neck and back strain from the collision. The injury
description is consistent with the mechanism and force of a head-on impact of this type.
11/22/2023
Requested prior medical records. No earlier injury to the neck or back has been identified in the records returned so
far.
12/03/2023
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Care has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of strain, and the
treating provider's notes explain the reasons for the extended course. Requested the clinical notes for further review.
01/20/2024
The claimant provided a follow-up statement that added a few minor details, such as the position of a nearby sign and
the timing of a brake application. The core account of the collision has remained the same across all statements.
01/30/2024
Summarized the file for supervisor review. Liability, vehicle damage, driver status, and injury consistency are all
supported by the available evidence. The open item is the extended treatment duration, which remains under review
pending the clinical notes.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
